headline: More Than 5 Companies Queue for IPO, Here's a Tip from BRI Danareksa
summary: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas says more than five companies are in the IPO pipeline on the Indonesia Stock Exchange. The prospective issuers are said to have larger business quality.
why: The IPO pipeline shows how many companies plan to list and raise capital, which affects supply of new shares on the exchange.
original_headline: Ada Lebih dari 5 Perusahaan Antre IPO, Ini Bocoran dari BRI Danareksa
